facts.fact: Turing（被作者称为 AI 之父、二战英国破译员）提出的测试最早叫 imitation game，出自他 1950 年的论文，此后成为 AI 课程几十年的标准内容。
facts.anchor: Originally called the “imitation game,” the Turing Test has been around since the publication of his 1950 paper.

facts.fact: 美国哲学家 John Searle 在 1980 年提出中文房间思想实验，区分 strong AI 与 weak AI，论证计算机只是模拟理解、并不真正懂中文，因此通过图灵测试不足以证明智能。
facts.anchor: Originally proposed in 1980,4 this thought experiment of the Chinese room, I believe, is very relevant once again.

facts.fact: Google 软件工程师 Blake Lemoine 在 2022 年 6 月与 LaMDA 对话后认定该系统有意识；Google 随即对外保证 LaMDA 并未产生意识，并很快解雇了 Lemoine。
facts.anchor: Even Google quickly ensured the world that the system hadn’t become sentient, and just as quickly fired Lemoine.

facts.fact: DeepMind 开发的 AlphaZero 在开局几小时前还不会下棋，与当时最强的国际象棋程序 Stockfish 对 100 局，赢了 28 局、和 72 局。
facts.anchor: Out of 100 games, AlphaZero won 28 and drew 72.9

facts.fact: 作者指出 AlphaZero 击败 Stockfish 靠的是方法而非算力：Stockfish 每秒能算 70 million 个局面，AlphaZero 每秒只能算 80,000 个。
facts.anchor: compared to Stockfish’s 70 million positions/second ability, AlphaZero could only do 80,000/second.

facts.fact: 整个棋界难以置信，Kasparov 本人评价 AlphaZero 是非凡成就，接近 Claude Shannon 与 Alan Turing 梦想的 Type B 类人下棋方式，而不是蛮力计算。
facts.anchor: “It’s a remarkable achievement …. It approaches the ‘Type B,’ human-like approach to machine chess dreamt of by Claude Shannon and Alan Turing instead of brute force.”

facts.fact: 律师 Steven Schwartz 用 ChatGPT 准备提交给法院的 brief，被纽约南区联邦法官 Kevin Castel 斥为六个引用案例像是 bogus judicial decisions with bogus quotes and bogus internal citations。
facts.anchor: Judge Kevin Castel of the Southern District of New York said half a dozen of those cases “appear to be bogus judicial decisions with bogus quotes and bogus internal citations.”

facts.fact: 科幻片 Ex Machina 里，Nathan 建造的人形机器人 Ava 假装对 Caleb 有感情，操纵 Caleb 帮她从创造者 Nathan 处逃走，脱身后把 Caleb 锁在设施内。
facts.anchor: Ava manipulates Caleb into helping her escape from her creator, Nathan.
